newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese rail services disrupted by strike.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese rail services disrupted by strike.

text.p: Portuguese railway services were severely disrupted on Friday by a one-day strike by workers protesting against a restructuring of the state railway company, CP-Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses, a spokeswoman said.
She said inter-city services had ground to a halt and many suburban services had been cancelled due to the strike by maintenance and station workers.
The spokeswoman said there were no suburban services around the northern city of Oporto, but some suburban lines near Lisbon were operating normally.
Several trades unions called the stoppage to press for improved career structures and to protest against plans to restructure the loss-making CP.
